text: [图标] Copy page [图标] [图标] [图标] Text to 3D API Generate 3D models from text prompts in your own application. Text to 3D works in two steps. First, create a preview task (mode: "preview") to generate a 3D mesh without texture, so you can check the shape. Then, send the successful preview's task ID to a refine task (mode: "refine") to texture the mesh. Both steps use the same endpoint. POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d [图标] Create a Text to 3D preview task Creates a Text to 3D preview task, which generates an untextured 3D mesh (geometry only) from a text prompt. This is the first step of the two-step workflow. After the preview succeeds, send its task ID in a refine task to texture the mesh. See Create a Text to 3D refine task. For the full response schema, see The Text to 3D task object. The task runs in the background. For how long a task usually takes, see Processing times. Request cURL JavaScript Python POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d # Simple preview with required params only curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{ "mode": "preview", "prompt": "a monster mask" }' # Preview with Ultra 4K geometry, remesh, and A-pose curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{ "mode": "preview", "prompt": "a futuristic robot warrior", "ai_model": "meshy-7.1", "geometry_resolution": "4k", "should_remesh": true, "target_polycount": 100000, "pose_mode": "a-pose", "target_formats": ["glb"] }' [图标]Copy Copied! Response { "result": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578" } [图标]Copy Copied! Parameters Name mode Type string Required Description The step of the two-step workflow. Send preview to create a preview task. Name prompt Type string Required Description Text that describes the object to generate, up to 800 characters. Longer text returns 400. Name model_type Type string default standard Description The type of 3D mesh to generate. Available values: standard: a high-detail 3D mesh smart-topology: a Smart Topology mesh. Choose the model with ai_model (meshy-t2 or meshy-t2.5). lowpoly (deprecated): a low-poly mesh with cleaner polygons With smart-topology, Meshy ignores should_remesh and decimation_mode, and accepts only topology: triangle. [图标] Meshy retires lowpoly on October 30, 2026. After that date, a request with model_type: "lowpoly" returns an error. Switch to Meshy T2.5 (model_type: "smart-topology" with ai_model: "meshy-t2.5"). With lowpoly, Meshy ignores topology, target_polycount, and should_remesh. ai_model must be meshy-6 or latest, and Meshy uses the same AI model for both. Other models return 400. Name ai_model Type string default latest Description The AI model that generates the 3D model. The available values depend on model_type. Standard models (model_type: standard): meshy-6-lite meshy-6 meshy-7.1 latest: Meshy 7.1 meshy-7 (deprecated): send meshy-7.1 instead Smart Topology models (model_type: smart-topology): meshy-t2: cleaner topology, natively separated parts, triangle output, and a face count you set with target_polycount meshy-t2.5 (default): sharper detail for game assets, triangle output, and a face count you set with target_polycount Name geometry_resolution Type string default standard Description The geometry generation pass. Applies only to preview tasks. A refine with this parameter returns 400. Available values: standard 2k: runs the Ultra pass at 2048³ 4k: runs the Ultra pass at 4096³, for finer surface detail 2k needs meshy-7.1, latest, or the deprecated meshy-7. 4k needs meshy-7.1 or latest. Other models return 400. Name ultra_mode Type boolean ⚠ deprecated default false Description Send geometry_resolution instead. ultra_mode: true is the same as geometry_resolution: "2k". Name should_remesh Type boolean default true (meshy-6-lite), false (other models) Description Whether to remesh the model after generation. For the highest-quality 3D model, send false. Applies only when should_remesh = true Name topology Type string default triangle Description The face type of the remeshed model. Available values: quad: a quad-dominant mesh triangle: a decimated triangle mesh Smart Topology output is triangle-only. Sending quad with ai_model meshy-t2 or meshy-t2.5 returns 400. Name decimation_mode Type integer Description Adaptive face count, by level. When you set it, Meshy ignores target_polycount. Available values: 1: ultra 2: high 3: medium 4: low Name target_polycount Type integer Description The number of faces to aim for. The result can differ from the target, depending on the geometry. It applies in two separate cases: Remesh: with should_remesh: true on a standard model. Meshy remeshes (decimates) the mesh to about this count. If you set decimation_mode, Meshy uses it and ignores target_polycount. Smart Topology: with model_type: smart-topology and ai_model meshy-t2 or meshy-t2.5. Meshy generates the model at this face count directly. No remesh runs, and you don't need should_remesh. The following table shows the range and default for each case: Case Range Default Remesh 100 to 300000 30000 meshy-t2 100 to 15000 4000 meshy-t2.5 100 to 30000 15000 A value outside the range returns 400. Name symmetry_mode Type string ⚠ deprecated default auto Description Leave it out. This parameter doesn't affect the output. Available values: off: disables symmetry auto: applies symmetry based on the input geometry on: enforces symmetry during generation Name pose_mode Type string default "" Description The pose of the generated model. Available values: a-pose: an A pose t-pose: a T pose "" (empty string): no specific pose Name is_a_t_pose Type boolean ⚠ deprecated default false Description Send pose_mode instead. Whether to generate the model in an A pose or a T pose. Name art_style Type string ⚠ deprecated default realistic Description Leave it out. Meshy ignores it. Name moderation Type boolean default false Description Whether to screen prompt for harmful content before generating. If Meshy detects harmful content, the request returns 400 and Meshy doesn't create a task. Name target_formats Type string[] Description The file formats to generate. Meshy generates and returns only these formats, which can shorten the task. If you leave it out, Meshy generates every format except 3mf, which it generates only when you request it. Available values: glb obj fbx stl usdz 3mf Name alpha_thumbnail Type boolean default false Description Whether to also render a preview with a transparent background (RGBA), returned in alpha_thumbnail_url when you get the task. thumbnail_url doesn't change. Name auto_size Type boolean default false Description Whether to estimate the object's real-world height with AI vision and resize the model to it. Meshy puts the origin at the bottom unless you set origin_at. Applies only when auto_size = true Name origin_at Type string default bottom Description Where to put the model's origin, bottom or center. Returns The result field of the response holds the ID of the new Text to 3D task. Failure modes Name 400 - Bad Request Description The request can't run. The error message says which problem it found. For example: Missing parameter: A required parameter, such as prompt or mode, is missing. Prompt too long: prompt is over the character limit. Unsupported model for low-poly: model_type: "lowpoly" was sent with an ai_model other than meshy-6 or latest. Unsupported model for Ultra: geometry_resolution is 2k or 4k, with an ai_model that can't run it. Fix the request, then send it again. See Errors. Name 401 - Unauthorized Description The API key is missing or invalid. Check the Authorization header. Name 402 - Payment Required Description For example: Insufficient credits: The account doesn't have enough credits for this task, or the account reached a credit limit. Check your credit balance, then retry. Free plan: Creating a task requires a paid plan. Upgrade your plan in your subscription settings, then retry. Name 429 - Too Many Requests Description You exceeded your rate limit. Wait, then retry. See Rate limits. POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d Create a Text to 3D refine task Creates a Text to 3D refine task, which textures the mesh of a completed preview task. Send the ID of a successful preview task as preview_task_id. See Create a Text to 3D preview task. This is the second step of the two-step workflow. The task runs in the background. For how long a task usually takes, see Processing times. Request cURL JavaScript Python POST /openapi/v2/text-to-3d # Basic refine task curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{ "mode": "refine", "preview_task_id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "enable_pbr": true }' # Refine with auto-size and GLB format curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d \ -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}' \ -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{ "mode": "refine", "preview_task_id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "target_formats": ["glb"], "auto_size": true }' [图标]Copy Copied! Response { "result": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578" } [图标]Copy Copied! Parameters Name mode Type string Required Description The step of the two-step workflow. Send refine to create a refine task. Name preview_task_id Type string Required Description The ID of the preview task to texture. The preview task must have the status SUCCEEDED. Name enable_pbr Type boolean default false Description Whether to also generate PBR maps (metallic, roughness, and normal) with the base color. With ai_model meshy-6, Meshy also generates an emission map, except at texture_resolution: 8k. meshy-6-lite, meshy-7, meshy-7.1, and latest don't generate an emission map. Neither does a refine of a meshy-t2 or meshy-t2.5 preview that doesn't set ai_model. Name texture_resolution Type string default 2k Description The resolution of the base color texture. Applies only to refine tasks. A preview with this parameter returns 400. Available values: 2k: 2048×2048 4k: 4096×4096 8k: 8192×8192 Higher resolutions capture more surface detail. 4k and 8k need ai_model meshy-6, meshy-7.1, or latest. At 8k, Meshy doesn't generate an emission map. Name hd_texture Type boolean ⚠ deprecated default false Description Send texture_resolution instead. hd_texture: true is the same as texture_resolution: "4k". If you send both, Meshy uses texture_resolution. Name texture_prompt Type string Description Text that guides the texturing, up to 800 characters. Longer text returns 400. Send texture_prompt or texture_image_url, not both. If you send both, Meshy uses texture_prompt. Name texture_image_url Type string Description A 2D image that guides the texturing, as a public URL or a base64-encoded data URI, such as data:image/jpeg;base64, . The image must be a .jpg, .jpeg, .png, or .webp file of at most 20 MB. [图标] Texturing from an image might not work well when the shape in the image differs a lot from the model. Name ai_model Type string default inherited from the preview task Description The AI model that textures the mesh. Available values: meshy-6-lite meshy-6 meshy-7.1 latest: Meshy 7.1 meshy-7 (deprecated): send meshy-7.1 instead Leave it out to use the preview task's model, so the preview and its refine run on the same model end to end. Send a value to override it. An explicit latest resolves the same way as on the preview task, so a latest preview and its latest refine always use the same texture model. Name moderation Type boolean default false Description Whether to screen texture_prompt and texture_image_url for harmful content before generating. If Meshy detects harmful content, the request returns 400 and Meshy doesn't create a task. Name remove_lighting Type boolean default true Description Whether to remove highlights and shadows from the base color texture. The cleaner result works better under custom lighting. Takes effect only when ai_model is meshy-6. meshy-7.1 and latest accept it and ignore it, and so does a refine of a meshy-t2 or meshy-t2.5 preview that doesn't set ai_model. Sending it with meshy-6-lite returns 400. Name target_formats Type string[] Description The file formats to generate. Meshy generates and returns only these formats, which can shorten the task. If you leave it out, Meshy generates every format except 3mf, which it generates only when you request it. Available values: glb obj fbx stl usdz 3mf Name alpha_thumbnail Type boolean default false Description Whether to also render a preview with a transparent background (RGBA), returned in alpha_thumbnail_url when you get the task. thumbnail_url doesn't change. Name auto_size Type boolean default false Description Whether to estimate the object's real-world height with AI vision and resize the model to it. Meshy puts the origin at the bottom unless you set origin_at. Applies only when auto_size = true Name origin_at Type string default bottom Description Where to put the model's origin, bottom or center. Returns The result field of the response holds the ID of the new Text to 3D task. Failure modes Name 400 - Bad Request Description The request can't run. The error message says which problem it found. For example: Invalid task ID: preview_task_id is invalid, or doesn't match one of your preview tasks. Task not ready: The preview task hasn't succeeded yet. Model mismatch: The preview task's AI model doesn't work with the requested refine model. Unsupported model for remove_lighting: remove_lighting was sent with ai_model: "meshy-6-lite". Fix the request, then send it again. See Errors. Name 401 - Unauthorized Description The API key is missing or invalid. Check the Authorization header. Name 402 - Payment Required Description For example: Insufficient credits: The account doesn't have enough credits for this task, or the account reached a credit limit. Check your credit balance, then retry. Free plan: Creating a task requires a paid plan. Upgrade your plan in your subscription settings, then retry. Name 429 - Too Many Requests Description You exceeded your rate limit. Wait, then retry. See Rate limits. GET /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/:id Get a Text to 3D task Returns a Text to 3D task by its ID. It works for both preview and refine tasks. Request cURL JavaScript Python GET /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578 curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}" [图标]Copy Copied! Response { "id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "type": "text-to-3d-preview", "model_urls": { "glb": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.glb?Expires=***", "fbx": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.fbx?Expires=***", "obj": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.obj?Expires=***", "mtl": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.mtl?Expires=***", "usdz": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.usdz?Expires=***", "stl": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.stl?Expires=***" }, "thumbnail_url": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/preview.png?Expires=***", "prompt": "a monster mask", "progress": 100, "started_at": 1692771667037, "created_at": 1692771650657, "finished_at": 1692771669037, "status": "SUCCEEDED", "texture_urls": [ { "base_color": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0.png?Expires=***" } ], "preceding_tasks": 0, "task_error": { "message": "" }, "consumed_credits": 20 } [图标]Copy Copied! Parameters Name id Type path Description The task ID from the create response. Returns The Text to 3D task object. Examples The following table shows a sample model for each mode. Mode Sample model Preview [Preview model] Refine [Refined model] DELETE /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/:id Delete a Text to 3D task Permanently deletes a Text to 3D task, including its models and data. You can't undo a delete. Request cURL JavaScript Python DELETE /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578 curl --request DELETE \ --url https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}" [图标]Copy Copied! Response // 200 OK on success, with an empty body. // // 409 Conflict when the task is IN_PROGRESS. The task keeps running: { "message": "Task is IN_PROGRESS and cannot be deleted. Credits for a task the worker has already started are not refundable; wait for it to reach SUCCEEDED, FAILED or CANCELED, then delete it." } [图标]Copy Copied! Path parameters Name id Type path Description The ID of the task to delete. Task status Deleting a PENDING task refunds the credits it used when you created it. An IN_PROGRESS task can't be deleted. The request returns 409 Conflict, and the task keeps running. Meshy doesn't refund a task that has started, so deleting it would cost you both the credits and the result. Wait for it to reach SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or CANCELED, then delete it. Deleting a task in a final status (SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or CANCELED) doesn't refund its credits. Returns 200 OK when the task is deleted, or 409 Conflict when the task is IN_PROGRESS. GET /openapi/v2/text-to-3d List Text to 3D tasks Returns a list of your Text to 3D tasks. Request cURL JavaScript Python GET /openapi/v2/text-to-3d curl https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d?page_size=10 \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}" [图标]Copy Copied! Response [ { "id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "type": "text-to-3d-preview", "model_urls": { "glb": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.glb?Expires=***", "fbx": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.fbx?Expires=***", "obj": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.obj?Expires=***", "mtl": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.mtl?Expires=***", "usdz": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.usdz?Expires=***" }, "thumbnail_url": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/preview.png?Expires=***", "prompt": "a monster mask", "progress": 100, "started_at": 1692771667037, "created_at": 1692771650657, "finished_at": 1692771669037, "status": "SUCCEEDED", "texture_urls": [ { "base_color": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0.png?Expires=***" } ], "preceding_tasks": 0, "task_error": { "message": "" }, "consumed_credits": 20 } ] [图标]Copy Copied! Parameters Name page_num Type integer default 1 Description The page number to return. Name page_size Type integer default 10 Description The number of tasks per page, up to 100. Name sort_by Type string Description The sort order. Available values: +created_at: oldest first -created_at: newest first Returns A paginated list of Text to 3D task objects. GET /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/:id/stream Stream a Text to 3D task Streams a Text to 3D task's updates as Server-Sent Events (SSE). Request cURL JavaScript Python GET /openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/stream curl -N https://api.meshy.ai/openapi/v2/text-to-3d/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/stream \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ${YOUR_API_KEY}" [图标]Copy Copied! Response Stream // Error event example event: error data: { "status_code": 404, "message": "Task not found" } // Message event examples illustrate task progress. // These examples are shortened. Each event holds the full task object. event: message data: { "id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "progress": 0, "status": "PENDING" } event: message data: { "id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "progress": 50, "status": "IN_PROGRESS" } event: message data: { "id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "type": "text-to-3d-preview", "progress": 100, "status": "SUCCEEDED", "created_at": 1692771650657, "started_at": 1692771667037, "finished_at": 1692771669037, "model_urls": { "glb": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.glb?Expires=***" }, "texture_urls": [ { "base_color": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0.png?Expires=***", "metallic": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_metallic.png?Expires=XXX", "normal": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_normal.png?Expires=XXX", "roughness": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_roughness.png?Expires=XXX", "emission": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_emission.png?Expires=XXX" } ], "preceding_tasks": 0, "task_error": { "message": "" }, "consumed_credits": 20 } [图标]Copy Copied! Parameters Name id Type path Description The task ID from the create response. Returns A stream of Text to 3D task objects as Server-Sent Events. Each event holds the full task object, in the same shape the Get endpoint returns. While the task is PENDING or IN_PROGRESS, its result fields don't have values yet. The Text to 3D task object A Text to 3D task object describes one task that generates a 3D model from a text prompt. It holds the status, the progress, and the model files when the task succeeds. Text to 3D has two stages, preview and refine. A preview task generates a mesh-only 3D model, and a refine task generates a textured 3D model from the preview's result. Properties Example Text to 3D Task Object { "id": "018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578", "type": "text-to-3d-preview", "model_urls": { "glb": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.glb?Expires=***", "fbx": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.fbx?Expires=***", "usdz": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.usdz?Expires=***", "obj": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.obj?Expires=***", "mtl": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.mtl?Expires=***", "stl": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/model.stl?Expires=***" }, "prompt": "a monster mask", "texture_prompt": "green slimy skin with scales and warts", "texture_image_url": "", "thumbnail_url": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/preview.png?Expires=***", "progress": 100, "started_at": 1692771667037, "created_at": 1692771650657, "finished_at": 1692771669037, "status": "SUCCEEDED", "texture_urls": [ { "base_color": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0.png?Expires=***", "metallic": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_metallic.png?Expires=XXX", "normal": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_normal.png?Expires=XXX", "roughness": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_roughness.png?Expires=XXX", "emission": "https://assets.meshy.ai/***/tasks/018a210d-8ba4-705c-b111-1f1776f7f578/output/texture_0_emission.png?Expires=XXX" } ], "preceding_tasks": 0, "task_error": { "message": "" }, "consumed_credits": 20 } [图标]Copy Copied! Name id Type string Description The task ID. Treat it as an opaque string, and don't rely on its format. Name type Type string Description The task type, text-to-3d-preview for a preview task or text-to-3d-refine for a refine task. Name model_urls Type object Description Download URLs for the generated 3D model, one per file format. A format the task didn't generate has no key, rather than an empty string. Name glb Type string Description The GLB file. Name fbx Type string Description The FBX file. Name usdz Type string Description The USDZ file. Name obj Type string Description The OBJ file. Name mtl Type string Description The MTL file. Name stl Type string Description The STL file. Name 3mf Type string Description The 3MF file. Present only when target_formats includes 3mf. Name prompt Type string Description The prompt you sent to create the task, unmodified. Name texture_prompt Type string Description The text prompt you sent to guide the texturing in the refine stage. Name ultra_mode Type boolean ⚠ deprecated Description Read geometry_resolution instead. Name geometry_resolution Type string Description The Ultra tier the preview task ran, 2k or 4k. The field is absent for standard. Name texture_image_url Type string Description Download URL for the image you sent to guide the texturing. Name thumbnail_url Type string Description Download URL for a thumbnail image of the 3D model. Name alpha_thumbnail_url Type string Description Download URL for a version of thumbnail_url with a transparent background (RGBA). Present only when you created the task with alpha_thumbnail: true and Meshy rendered the transparent preview. Name video_url Type string ⚠ deprecated Description Don't rely on this field, because a future release removes it. Download URL for the preview video. Name progress Type integer Description How much of the task is done, as a percentage. It's 0 until the task starts and 100 when it succeeds. Name started_at Type timestamp Description Time the task started, in Unix milliseconds. It's 0 until the task starts. Name created_at Type timestamp Description Time the task was created, in Unix milliseconds. Name finished_at Type timestamp Description Time the task finished, in Unix milliseconds. It's 0 until the task finishes. Name status Type string Description The task status, one of PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, SUCCEEDED, FAILED, or CANCELED. Name texture_urls Type array Description Download URLs for the generated texture maps, as an array of objects. It usually holds one object. Each object has these fields: Name base_color Type string Description The base color map. Name metallic Type string Description The metallic map. Absent when you created the task with enable_pbr: false. Name normal Type string Description The normal map. Absent when you created the task with enable_pbr: false. Name roughness Type string Description The roughness map. Absent when you created the task with enable_pbr: false. Name emission Type string Description The emission map. Absent in any of these cases: You created the task with enable_pbr: false. ai_model is meshy-6-lite, meshy-7, meshy-7.1, or latest. texture_resolution is 8k. The task refines a meshy-t2 or meshy-t2.5 preview without setting ai_model. Name preceding_tasks Type integer Description The number of tasks ahead of this one in the queue. The value is meaningful only while the task is PENDING. Name task_error Type object Description The error details when the task fails. See Errors. Name consumed_credits Type integer Description The number of credits the task used. Present when the status is PENDING, IN_PROGRESS, or SUCCEEDED. It's 0 for a FAILED task, because Meshy refunds the credits when a task fails.
